data.why: The app reads precomputed NDVI forecast NetCDF artifacts already committed in docs/app_data; no upload mechanism or additional data is needed.

goals: Determine whether machine learning models (GBT/ConvLSTM/GNN) beat simple persistence and climatology baselines for next-month NDVI in a given biome
Compare forecast skill across Australia's four biomes (tropical, subtropical, arid, alpine) to see where models add value versus where baselines are hard to beat
See how the headline conclusion changes when switching from the 11-year Sentinel-2 record to the 40-year Landsat record
Inspect a single pixel's forecast trajectory over time against actual NDVI, persistence, and climatology
Check whether a model's conformal uncertainty interval is well-calibrated by comparing observed coverage to the nominal confidence level
Visually compare a model's spatial forecast map and error map against the actual NDVI image for a chosen month

review.summary: The tree states the tool's core question well (do ML forecasters beat persistence and climatology across biomes and record lengths), and the skill-chart and map phases are well structured and match their screens. But the pixel time series and conformal-calibration workflows, two of the six stated goals, are missing because scipy wasn't installed, and one label overstates the Landsat result, so it needs a targeted re-run and edits before filing.
